literal: Greatness-yielding wealth even if obtained, to others harm not doing [is] blemish-without-those's principle.
translation: Even if it brings wealth that yields greatness, not doing harm to others is the firm principle of the flawless.
modern: சிறப்பைத் தரும் செல்வத்தைப் பெறுவதாக இருந்தாலும், மற்றவர்களுக்குத் துன்பம் செய்யாமல் இருப்பதே குற்றமற்றவர்களின் கொள்கையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the core principle of those who are free from moral blemishes. It states that they will never cause harm to others, even if doing so would bring them immense wealth and greatness. The phrase 'மாசற்றார் கோள்' (the resolve of the flawless) emphasizes that true purity lies in the absolute refusal to do harm. The contrast between 'சிறப்பீனும் செல்வம்' (wealth yielding greatness) and 'இன்னா செய்யாமை' (not doing harm) highlights that no material or social gain can ever justify inflicting pain on others.
